_note: END-008 Battery Health Monitoring: the parts of the battery_monitoring.exe input that the power budget does not contain. STAR fills mission (name, duration: Test = 1 year, Full = the mission lifetime of the requirements), pack.cells_in_parallel (battery energy of the END-006 design / cell energy x cells in series), pack.temperature_C (END-019 mean battery temperature, else 20 degC) and simulation.time_step_s (Test 120 s, Full 60 s); orbit, subsystems, modes and schedule come from the END-004 power budget through power_budget_to_input.py. Keys starting with _ are notes. See END008-BatteryHealthMonitoring/README.md for the meaning of every field.

cell._note: assumption: END-006 publishes only the battery energy; 18650 cell of the END-008 example
